chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Safwan al-Jammal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who does not have a sacrificial animal with him and performs exclusive (Hajj) turning away from the Tamattu', so he has turned away from the Religion of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الْمُتْعَةِ: Tamattu' (a type of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj)
key_terms.هَدْيٌ: Sacrificial animal brought by the pilgrim

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a pilgrim who does not bring a sacrificial animal and performs Hajj al-Ifrad?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from al-Kafi underscores the superiority of Hajj al-Tamattu' by linking the performance of the sacrificial animal (hady) to the completeness of one's devotion. It implies that rejecting the combined form of Umrah and Hajj is not merely a legal preference but a spiritual departure from the Religion of Allah, a view supported by many Shia scholars who consider it the most recommended form of pilgrimage. This ruling highlights the theological weight of the hady as a symbol of commitment to the divine commandments during the pilgrimage.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from safwan Al Jammal, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one does not happen to have a sacrificial animal with him, and he performs exclusive (Hajj) turning away from the Tamatto, so he has turned away from the Religion of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about my performing al-‘Umrah in the month of Rajab and that I wanted to perform al-Hajj, if driving the offering animal and Mufrid al-Hajj was better or al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous). He (the Imam) said, ‘In each one there is goodness and beauty.’ I then asked, ‘Which one is more virtuous?’ He (the Imam) said that ‘Al-Hajj al-Tamattu‘ (advantageous) by Allah is more virtuous.’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘People of Makkah say that his al-‘Umrah is Iraqiy and his al-Hajj is Makkiy. They by Allah speak a lie. Is not al-‘Umrah related to his al-Hajj from which he cannot come out unless he completes them all?’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘I used to go for al-‘Umrah one or two nights before the end of the month of Rajab and ‘Umm Farwah would say, “O father, our al-‘Umrah is in the month of al-Sha‘ban.” I would say, “My daughter it will be of the time when I commence not of the time when I will come out of the state of Ihram.’””
